method: Local file integrity audit and static contract analysis; no live requests, load benchmark or clinical validation

capacity.projectionMethod: Existing record schema, proposed unit titles, G/W/P title prefixes and current metadata; synthetic hashes have fixed length. Not actual future content.
capacity.stressCase: Add 40 Hebrew characters to both title and unitTitle on every new record; +160 bytes per new record
capacity.pdfProjectionMethod: 81 guides and 600 sheets at existing expansion means; excludes extra companion PDFs, source HTML, code and backups
capacity.serverStorageBehavior: loadPilot reads all PDFs into an in-memory Map at startup; raw byte estimate is not total process RAM

youngChildContract.validationType: static predicate and identifier checks, not browser E2E
youngChildContract.existingOcdCH: Existing 8–11 materials remain distinct; no silent age relabeling

releaseConstraints: new version/path/count/SHA must be pinned in shared releases.js
server loader/catalog registration and browser release fallback need a coordinated reviewed release
retain 512KiB catalog and 1MiB file bounds unless a separately reviewed bounded architecture is required
no live deployment, publish, auth change or treatment PDFs in Stage 0
